    function normalizeUrl(u) {
        try {
            const url = new URL(u);
            url.pathname = url.pathname.toLowerCase().replace(/\/+$/, '');
            return url.toString();
        } catch (e) {
            return u.toLowerCase();
        }
    }

    // PAGE_VIEW inicial
    (function () {
        var raw = location.href;
        var u = normalizeUrl(raw);

        });
    })();

    // Listener defensivo: hash, pushState, replaceState
    (function () {
        var lastUrl = location.href;

        function sendPvIfChanged() {
            var current = location.href;
            if (current !== lastUrl) {
                lastUrl = current;
                gtag('event', 'page_view', {
                    page_location: normalizeUrl(current),
                    page_title: document.title
                });
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('hashchange', sendPvIfChanged);

        history.pushState = new Proxy(history.pushState, {
            apply: function (target, thisArg, args) {
                var ret = Reflect.apply(target, thisArg, args);
                sendPvIfChanged();
                return ret;
            }
        });

        history.replaceState = new Proxy(history.replaceState, {
            apply: function (target, thisArg, args) {
                var ret = Reflect.apply(target, thisArg, args);
                sendPvIfChanged();
                return ret;
            }
        });
    })();

            <input type="button" name="ctl00$wBusqueda$btnBuscar" value="" onclick="javascript:WebForm_DoPostBackWithOptions(new WebForm_PostBackOptions(&quot;ctl00$wBusqueda$btnBuscar&quot;, &quot;&quot;, true, &quot;BuscadorTutorizado&quot;, &quot;&quot;, false, true))" id="ctl00_wBusqueda_btnBuscar" accesskey="3" title="Buscar" class="btn-buscar" AlternateText="Buscar" aria-label="Buscar" />

    <script type="text/javascript">

        let UrlAPISuggestsHeader = "";

        document.getElementById("ctl00_wBusqueda_txtBusqueda").addEventListener("keyup", HandleKeyBoard);
        document.getElementById("ctl00_wBusqueda_txtBusqueda").addEventListener("change", HandleKeyBoard);

        function getSuggestions() {            
            const txtBusqueda = document.getElementById("ctl00_wBusqueda_txtBusqueda"); 
            const suggestions = document.getElementById("dlSuggestionsHead");
            let textoBusqueda = txtBusqueda.value;
            txtBusqueda.setAttribute("list", "dlSuggestionsHead");

            if (textoBusqueda == null || textoBusqueda.trim() == "") {
                suggestions.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            //const apiUrl = "https://api.addsearch.com/v1/suggest/633a972c763896c037c28e6d1712fb15?term=" + textoBusqueda + "&size=10";
            const apiUrl = UrlAPISuggestsHeader.replace("{0}", textoBusqueda).replace("{1}", "10");
            suggestions.innerHTML = '';

            fetch(apiUrl)
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error('Error en la solicitud');
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(data => {
                    suggestions.innerHTML = '';

                    data.suggestions.forEach(suggestion => {
                        const suggestionDiv = document.createElement('option');
                        suggestionDiv.value = suggestion.value;
                        suggestions.appendChild(suggestionDiv);
                    });
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.log('Error al consumir la API:', error);
                });         
        }

        function HandleKeyBoard(event) {
            if (event.keyCode === 13 || event.keyCode === undefined) {
                document.getElementById("ctl00_wBusqueda_btnBuscar").click();
            }
            else {
                getSuggestions();
            }            
        }
    </script>
